def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(value for value in counts if value not in (0, background))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    min_r = min(r for r, c in points)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in points]
    shape_h = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    shape_w = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    for r in range(h - shape_h + 1):
        for c in range(w - shape_w + 1):
            cells = [(r + dr, c + dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if all(grid[x][y] == 0 for x, y in cells):
                for x, y in cells:
                    out[x][y] = marker
    return out
'''
